explanation: The response identifies AlCoCrFeNi2.1 as a possible eutectic HEA and predicts the correct qualitative ductile–brittle–ductile sequence, so it retains limited reconstruction value. However, it misses the central result: as-cast FCC+B2 AlCoCrFeNi2.1 undergoes the transition after aging within a roughly 550–750°C window, with minimum ductility after 600°C aging and recovery after 750°C aging. It instead proposes a different engineered precipitate architecture and attributes behavior to matrix crack bridging. The experiment can test its own broad hypothesis, but it would not specifically distinguish the target ordering/phase-boundary mechanism; it lacks measurements of L12 ordering, APBE-related slip behavior, jagged boundary tips, and exclusion of impurity-segregation-driven intergranular fracture.
